## How do I move my books from QuickBooks Desktop?

<a id="migrate-from-quickbooks"></a>

Migrate from QuickBooks brings your books over in three steps: lists first, then history, then open invoices and bills.

**Where:** **Setup › Migrate from QuickBooks** (`/qb-import`)

1. Open Migrate from QuickBooks (File > Migrate from QuickBooks…, or "Convert from QuickBooks…" on the start screen). → **Setup › Migrate from QuickBooks** (`/qb-import`)
2. Step 1 · Chart of accounts and lists (IIF / CSV / Excel) — start here: export your lists from QuickBooks as IIF and import them.
3. Step 2 · History from your General Ledger: import a QuickBooks General Ledger report as PDF, Excel or CSV. It is checked to the penny against the trial balance before anything is saved.
4. Step 3 · Open invoices and unpaid bills: import them as real documents, so you can receive payments and pay bills on day one.
5. Payroll mid-year? Enter what was already paid this year in Payroll setup. → **Accounting › Payroll Setup** (`/employees/setup`)

> Good to know: Do the steps in order: history needs the accounts from Step 1.
>
> Good to know: Try the whole move on a copy first with "Try it on a copy".

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I move my books from QuickBooks Desktop?", or ask Ask AI.*

## Where is the QuickBooks screen I am used to?

<a id="quickbooks-names"></a>

Every screen keeps its QuickBooks name for search, and the menus can show QuickBooks names. The QuickBooks keyboard shortcuts work too.

**Where:** **Setup › My Preferences** (`/my-preferences`)

1. Press Ctrl+K, or use the menu search box, and type the QuickBooks name: "Write Checks", "Memorized Transactions", "Finance Charges".
2. To have the menus use QuickBooks names, turn on "Use QuickBooks names in the menu" in My Preferences. → **Setup › My Preferences** (`/my-preferences`)
3. Press ? on any page for the shortcuts: Ctrl+W Write Checks, Ctrl+I Invoice, Ctrl+J Customer Center, Ctrl+A Chart of Accounts, Ctrl+R Register, Ctrl+F Find.

> Good to know: docs/guide/quickbooks-names.md lists every QuickBooks screen name beside its Ironbooks screen.

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "Where is the QuickBooks screen I am used to?", or ask Ask AI.*

## How do I get my data out of Ironbooks?

<a id="export-data"></a>

Lists and transactions export to IIF, CSV and Excel, and the whole ledger exports as an Excel workbook or PDF.

**Where:** **Setup › Migrate from QuickBooks** (`/qb-import`)

1. Open Migrate from QuickBooks and use "Export lists and transactions". → **Setup › Migrate from QuickBooks** (`/qb-import`)
2. For the ledger: File > Export Shareable Ledger, as an Excel Workbook (.xlsx) or a PDF Summary (.pdf).
3. The Chart of Accounts has its own "Export CSV". → **Accounting › Chart of Accounts** (`/accounts`)

*In the app: Help & Glossary → "How do I get my data out of Ironbooks?", or ask Ask AI.*
